title: Quenched Umami British Collards Shepherd's Pie
description: A comforting, velvety vegetarian take on the classic shepherd's pie, featuring wilted collards and a rich bain-marie sauce.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of the oil in the cataplana over medium heat. Add the onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and lightly browned, about 8 minutes. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly. Add the collard greens and cook, stirring occasionally, until wilted, about 5 minutes. Sprinkle the flour over the greens and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly. Gradually add the broth, whisking continuously, and cook until the mixture thickens, about 5 minutes. Stir in the soy sauce, miso paste, tomato paste, cumin, nutmeg, and cayenne. Season with salt and black pepper to taste. Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C). In a separate saucepan, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil over medium heat. Whirl the heavy cream in a blender or with an immersion blender until smooth. Add the cream to the saucepan and cook, stirring constantly, until heated through. Stir in the grated cheese until melted and smooth. Transfer the cataplana to the oven and top with the cream and cheese mixture. Bake, covered, for 25 minutes. Remove the lid and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the filling is hot and bubbly. Garnish with chopped scallions and serve hot.
